sermon.title: Predicted Persecutions— July 26, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows how Scripture predicted Messiah’s persecution and Jerusalem’s fall, from Daniel’s seventy weeks to AD 70, teaching that Matthew 24’s great tribulation was Israel’s destruction. All who live godly will suffer persecution. Believers should rejoice, beware impostors, fight for their families and rescue the weak.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: How long was the Jews’ tribulation?
faqs.answer: He says it went on until 1948 when Israel became a nation — a 2,000-year tribulation.

faqs.question: Should family division surprise us?
faqs.answer: No. Jesus predicted it; He said He did not come to bring peace.

faqs.question: What does the closing verse call us to?
faqs.answer: Rescue the weak, the orphans and the needy from unjust judgment.
